rejectedOfflineExperiments: Connected neutral/A-pose surfaces, harmonic and automatic weights, mirrored topology, corrective shapes, and current-pose fairing were examined. None passed the combined appearance, continuous-motion surface, thickness, and runtime requirements.
PolarProbe and GentlePolar were offline-only numerical probes; their extra preview deformation is not implemented by the saved Unity transport. They must not be presented as validated game models.

restoredValidation.meaning: Verifies restoration of the existing version, not resolution of the requested model defects.

remaining: A continuous rounded shoulder attachment that does not fold during raised-arm and combat poses.
A model that simultaneously retains arm thickness, symmetry, and the approved torso proportions.
Native/Unity parity and performance validation of an acceptable final asset.
